ANCOVA

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
data(diamonds)

library(readxl)
ANCOVATP <- read_excel("ANCOVATP.xlsx")
Survie=ANCOVATP$Survie
Treat=ANCOVATP$Treat
Age=ANCOVATP$Age

```

```{r}
#modele <- lm(price ~ carat + cut, data = diamonds)


modele2=lm(Survie~Age+Treat,data=ANCOVATP)
anova(modele2)
aov(modele2)

```
